translations.word: Oil Coke| Black solid residue, obtained mainly by cracking and carbonising of petroleum derived feedstock, vacuum bottoms, tar and pitches in processes such as delayed coking or fluid coking. It consists mainly of carbon (90 to 95 per cent) and has a low ash content. It is used as a feedstock in coke ovens for the steel industry, for heating purposes, for electrode manufacture and for production of chemicals. The two most important qualities are "green coke" and "calcined coke". This category also includes "catalyst coke" deposited on the catalyst during refining processes: this coke is not recoverable and is usually burned as refinery fuel.

translations.word: Household Sector|Household is considered the institutional unit of this sector. A household is defined as a group of individuals who live together, pool their income or wealth to cover living expenses, and consume certain goods and services collectively, such as housing and food. Domestic servants paid by the household for their services are not considered part of the household, even if they live in the same dwelling, as the provision of food and accommodation is regarded as in-kind remuneration. Since domestic servants do not share in the household’s income, they are therefore treated as separate households. These units also include household members who reside in institutions, such as long-term patients in hospitals, persons in places of worship, or prisoners serving long sentences. Elderly persons living in nursing homes are likewise considered institutional households.
